title: 第7章 农田建设与虫草第8章 发现盐矿与招募卫兵
slug: 穿越自带炼妖壶桀桀顷刻炼化
content_zh:
夏末的风卷着火星，在庄园西侧的荒地上画出一道橙红的弧线。
农奴们举着削尖的长杆，将蔓延的火焰赶向划定的区域，野草与灌木在火中蜷曲、爆裂，升腾的黑烟里混着草木灰的气息，落在皮肤上带着微烫的暖意。
“顺着地界烧！别让火过界！”
劳恩的吼声混在噼啪的燃烧声里，他骑着马在火场边缘游走。
“东边是清水河，烧到河边就停！”
罗恩站在高坡上，看着火焰像一条躁动的巨蛇，慢慢啃噬着眼前的荒原。
这把火要烧透一天，把深扎在土里的杂草根茎彻底烧死，灰烬渗入土壤，再由农奴翻滚土地，才能为精灵虫的虫草提供最适宜的温床。
一天后，火焰熄灭，留下一片焦黑的土地。
农奴们扛着锄头踏入这片温热的田垄，铁刃落下时，焦土应声碎裂，露出下面深褐色的沃土。
迪克踩着田埂来回呵斥：
“都给我仔细点！土块敲碎！草根捡干净！耽误了播种，仔细你们的皮！”
罗恩没理会他的严苛。
在开拓地，对农奴的纵容往往意味着效率低下。
迪克的刻薄虽碍眼，却能让活计更快推进。
总不能让他这个贵族老爷亲自下场吧。
罗恩转身回了庄园。
从领主木屋取出五个玉盒。每个玉盒里都静静躺着一对“搭档”，一只沉睡的精灵虫，与一根半尺长的虫草。
精灵虫照片
蔷薇虫草泛着粉紫光泽，隐隐有光流动，蔷薇精灵虫就是家族给予的魔药精灵虫。
“佩林，按划定的区域播种。”罗恩打开第一个玉盒，指尖捏住粉紫色的虫草。

“记住，把虫草都种在离庄园近的土地上，每个虫草都给我安排人专门日夜守护。
“外围再种普通的作物。”
佩林捧着羊皮地图，在一旁回道：“大人，此次还开拓出五百亩番薯区，五百亩黑麦区，五百亩小麦区。”
“这些普通作物，你看着安排就好了”
精灵虫草的覆盖范围只有100亩，而就是这100亩的产量就抵得上农奴耕种田地的4倍。
罗恩将蔷薇虫草放入坑中，又小心翼翼地在旁边埋下玉石和黄金粉末。
精灵虫最喜欢吃这些东西，每一次移栽虫草都会对精灵虫造成一些影响，移栽的多了，还可能会影响精灵虫进化，所以需要进行补充。
罗恩的几只精灵虫从入手就在玉盒里沉睡，他打算移栽好后，就试试原液对这些小家伙有用不。
要是有用，他还不得起飞啊。
虫草刚种下，玉盒里的精灵虫就慢慢悠悠地醒了过来。咕扭着身子，迫不及待地向罗恩的手爬去，然后一口一口地啃着黄金。
这些精灵虫都和罗恩签订了契约，罗恩能够模模糊糊地感觉到，精灵虫此时愉悦的心情！
等精灵虫吃饱了，它就慢慢悠悠的爬回了虫草上。
在虫草顶端晃了晃，突然展开翅膀，绕着虫草飞了两圈，下一刻，以虫草为中心，周围的土地突然泛起淡淡的粉紫光晕，像一层薄纱笼罩着田垄，连空气里都多了丝清甜气息。
“这就是……覆盖范围？”罗恩心中微动。
接着将另外4棵虫草种下。分别是小麦、黑麦，蒲公英蔷薇精灵虫。
接下来的两日，领地内的工作就是种植虫草区作物，然后去耕种其他的土地。
content_en:
The late summer wind swept the sparks, drawing an orange-red arc on the wasteland on the west side of the manor.
The serfs held up sharpened long poles and drove the spreading flames towards the designated area. The wild grass and shrubs curled and burst in the fire. The rising black smoke was mixed with the smell of plant ash, and fell on the skin with a slightly burning warmth.
"Burn along the boundary! Don't let the fire cross the boundary!"
Raun's roar was mixed with the crackling sound of fire, and he rode around the edge of the fire.
"To the east is the Qingshui River. The burning will stop when it reaches the river!"
Ron stood on the high slope, watching the flames like a restless snake, slowly gnawing at the wasteland in front of him.
This fire will burn through for a day, completely burning the weed roots deep in the soil. The ashes will seep into the soil, and then the serfs will turn the land to provide the most suitable breeding ground for the Cordyceps of the elf bugs.
A day later, the flames died out, leaving behind a scorched earth.
The serfs carried hoes and stepped into the warm field ridges. When the iron blade fell, the scorched earth shattered, revealing the dark brown fertile soil below.
Dick stepped on the field ridge and yelled back and forth:
"Please be careful! Crush the soil clods! Pick up the grass roots! You've delayed sowing, so be careful with your skins!"
Ron ignored his harshness.
In the pioneer lands, pampering serfs often meant inefficiency.
Dick's meanness was an eyesore, but it made the job go faster.
We can't let him, a noble man, die personally.
Ron turned and returned to the manor.
Take out five jade boxes from the lord's cabin. In each jade box lies a pair of "partners": a sleeping fairy insect and a half-foot-long Cordyceps sinensis.
Elf bug photos
The rose cordyceps have a pink-purple luster, and there is a faint flow of light. The rose fairy bugs are the magical fairy bugs given by the family.
"Palin, sow seeds according to the designated area." Ron opened the first jade box and held the pink and purple cordyceps between his fingertips.
"Remember, plant all the cordyceps on the land close to the manor, and I will assign someone to guard each cordyceps day and night.
“Plant ordinary crops on the periphery. "
Palin held the sheepskin map and replied from the side: "Sir, this time we have also opened up 500 acres of sweet potato area, 500 acres of rye area, and 500 acres of wheat area. "
"You just have to look at the arrangements for these ordinary crops."
The coverage area of Elf Cordyceps is only 100 acres, and the output of just 100 acres is worth four times of the fields cultivated by serfs.
Ron put the rose cordyceps into the pit and carefully buried jade and gold powder next to it.
Elf bugs like to eat these things. Every time you transplant Cordyceps, it will have some impact on the Elf Bugs. If you transplant too much, it may also affect the evolution of Elf Bugs, so it needs to be supplemented.
Several of Ron's elf bugs have been sleeping in the jade box since he first bought them. He plans to try to see if the original solution is useful for these little guys after transplanting them.
If it was useful, he wouldn't be allowed to take off.
As soon as the cordyceps were planted, the fairy bugs in the jade box slowly woke up. Gu twisted around and crawled towards Ron's hand impatiently, then gnawed on the gold one bite at a time.
These elf bugs have signed contracts with Ron, and Ron can vaguely feel the happy mood of the elf bugs at this time!
When the elf worm was full, it slowly crawled back to the cordyceps.
He swayed on the top of the Cordyceps, suddenly spread his wings, and flew around the Cordyceps twice. The next moment, with the Cordyceps as the center, the surrounding land suddenly glowed with a faint pink-purple halo, like a layer of gauze covering the field ridges, and even the air was filled with a sweet smell.
“This is… coverage? "Ron's heart moved slightly.
Then plant another 4 cordyceps plants. They are wheat, rye, dandelion, rose fairy bug.
In the next two days, the work in the territory will be to plant crops in the cordyceps area and then cultivate other lands.
